  subtype_label: "myeloid"
  condition_levels: !r c("41BB-L", "B7H3", "CD28-41BB", "CD8-41BB", "STOP", "tumor")
  car_levels: !r c("41BB-L", "B7H3", "CD28-41BB", "CD8-41BB")

## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)  
library(dplyr)  
library(Seurat)  
library(ggplot2)  
library(tidyverse)  
library(SeuratObject)  
library(scCustomize)  
library(sccomp) 

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v4")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```

## Parameters
```{r}
input_rds <- params$input_rds
subtype_label <- params$subtype_label
condition_levels <- params$condition_levels
car_levels <- params$car_levels

cell_group_col <- paste0(subtype_label, "_subtype")

# output label
analysis_label <- paste0(subtype_label, "_subtype")

# CAR-only sccomp parameter names relative to baseline
car_only_parameters <- paste0("condition", setdiff(car_levels, "41BB-L"))

cat("Input RDS:", input_rds, "\n")
cat("Subtype label:", subtype_label, "\n")
cat("Cell group column:", cell_group_col, "\n")
cat("Condition levels:", paste(condition_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("CAR levels:", paste(car_levels, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
# Load Seurat object
obj <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, input_rds))

stopifnot(cell_group_col %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
stopifnot("sample" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
stopifnot("condition" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data))
```

## Composition analysis using sccomp
## 41BB-L is set as the reference condition
```{r composition-analysis-sccomp, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 41BB-L (first level) is used as the baseline reference
sccomp_input <- obj@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    sample = sample,
    cell_group = all_of(cell_group_col),
    condition
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    condition = factor(condition, levels = condition_levels)
  ) %>%
  as_tibble()

cat("Reference condition for sccomp:", levels(sccomp_input$condition)[1], "\n")
cat("Cell group column used for analysis:", cell_group_col, "\n")

sccomp_result <- sccomp_input |>
  sccomp_estimate(
    formula_composition = ~ condition,
    .sample = sample,
    .cell_group = cell_group,
    bimodal_mean_variability_association = TRUE,
    cores = 4,
    verbose = FALSE
  ) |>
  sccomp_test()

write.table(
  sccomp_result,
  file = file.path(results_dir, paste0(analysis_label, "_composition_sccomp_41BBL_baseline_results.tsv")),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r visualize-sccomp-results, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
sccomp_result |> 
  plot_1D_intervals(significance_statistic = c("FDR"))
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, paste0(analysis_label, "_composition_sccomp_41BBL_baseline.pdf")), width = 14, height = 6)
```

## Subtypes Not Significantly Altered vs 41BB-L (All Conditions)
```{r subtype-not-sig-all}
## Identify myeloid subtypes that are NOT significantly different 
## from 41BB-L across ALL treatment conditions
not_sig_subtypes <- sccomp_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(parameter != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(any_sig = any(c_FDR < 0.05)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!any_sig) %>%
  dplyr::pull(cell_group)

print(not_sig_subtypes)

cat("\nSummary:\n")
cat(
  length(not_sig_subtypes),
  analysis_label,
  "(s) show no significant compositional change relative to 41BB-L across all conditions.\n"
)
```

## Subtypes Not Significantly Altered vs 41BB-L (CAR Constructs Only)
```{r subtype-not-sig-car-only}
## Restrict analysis to CAR constructs only (exclude STOP and tumor)
res_cars_only <- sccomp_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(parameter %in% car_only_parameters)

not_sig_subtypes_cars <- res_cars_only %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(any_sig = any(c_FDR < 0.05)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!any_sig) %>%
  dplyr::pull(cell_group)

print(not_sig_subtypes_cars)

cat("\nCAR-only Summary:\n")
cat(
  length(not_sig_subtypes_cars),
  analysis_label,
  "(s) show no significant compositional change relative to 41BB-L among CAR constructs only.\n"
)
```

## Stacked barplot of subtype proportions
```{r subtype-stacked-barplot}
prop_df <- obj@meta.data %>%
  count(condition, .data[[cell_group_col]]) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(cell_group = all_of(cell_group_col))

write.table(
  prop_df,
  file = file.path(results_dir, paste0(analysis_label, "_proportions.tsv")),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = condition, y = prop, fill = cell_group)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = DiscretePalette(n = length(unique(prop_df$cell_group)))
  ) +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, paste0(analysis_label, "_proportions_stacked_barplot.png")),
  width = 8,
  height = 5
)
```
